description: This PHP class defines the LeaveEntitlementDao which manages leave entitlement data in the HRM system. It provides methods for accessing, updating, and handling leave entitlement records, including calculations for leave balances and associations with leave records.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing leave entitlement entities. Provides methods for CRUD operations, calculations, and complex queries related to leave entitlements within the HR system.

methods.name: getPendingStatusIds
methods.description: Returns an array containing the ID for the pending leave approval status.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches leave entitlement records based on supplied filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave entitlement records matching the filter.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsSum
methods.description: Calculates the total number of entitlement days based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LeaveEntitlement entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Persists a LeaveEntitlement entity to the database within a transaction, linking it to unused leave records.

methods.name: bulkLinkLeaveToUnusedLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Links multiple leave records to leave entitlements in bulk, distributing leave days proportionally.

methods.name: linkLeaveToUnusedLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Links individual leave records to an entitlement, assigning leave days accordingly.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveEntitlementIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs for existing leave entitlements matching the provided IDs.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple LeaveEntitlement entities by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Marks specified leave entitlements as deleted in the database.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees in a bulk operation, with transactional safety and optional testing of leave period policies.

methods.name: getValidLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Retrieves leave entitlements valid for a particular employee and date range, ordered by a specified field.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Computes and returns the leave balance for an employee and leave type as of a specific date.

methods.name: getEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Retrieves usage data for a specific leave record, including the linked entitlements and leave days used.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches leave records outside of entitlements, with options to filter by employee, date range, and leave status.

methods.name: getMatchingEntitlements
methods.description: Retrieves leave entitlements matching specified employee, date, and leave type criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns leave types applicable for an entitlement usage report, filtered by various parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types for the entitlement usage report.

methods.name: getEmployeesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Retrieves employee details for an entitlement usage report based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns the number of employees matching report filters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdsForEntitlementsByEmployee
methods.description: Returns leave type IDs for entitlements associated with a specific employee within a date range.
